title: Space-Time Tradeoffs of Pauli-Based Computation in Distributed qLDPC Architectures
summary: Pauli-based computation (PBC) provides a universal framework for executing fault-tolerant quantum algorithms using Pauli measurements and magic states. In monolithic architectures, the serialized nature of PBC directly ties runtime to a circuit's T-gate count, making it slow on metrics like circuit depth. However, in distributed quantum computing (DQC), the primary bottleneck is remote Bell pair generation.
